output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The '_transfer' function has an integer overflow that allows users to cause a denial of service (make balances become zero).
The 'burn' function has an integer overflow allowing the owner to set the balance of an attacker to any value and causing a denial of service.

output_list.vulnerability: The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows an attacker to cause a denial of service (burnFrom can cause an attacker's balance to underflow and become zero).
